description.short_caption: Photograph of a long, thin worm excreted in stool.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a long, cylindrical worm with a smooth, uniform surface, likely a nematode, placed on a white background. The worm appears intact, with tapered ends, and measures several centimeters in length. The setting suggests it was collected after defecation, consistent with a parasitic infection.

description.short_caption: Photograph of a long, thin parasitic organism on a white background.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a long, thin, cylindrical organism with a smooth surface, consistent with a parasitic worm. The organism is displayed on a white background, likely for contrast and clarity. The tapering at one end suggests a nematode, though the specific species cannot be determined from this image alone. The photograph provides a clear view of the organism's length and general morphology.
